title: WPSS/1802/2016 of Anil AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1802 of 2016

Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö.ÖRespondents
Presence : Mr. P.S. Uniyal, Advocate for the petitioners.
 Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
 Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for respondent No.2.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. The petitioners are working on the post of Security
Guard in different Cooperative Banks on daily rated basis. The
petitioners have challenged the advertisement dated 16.05.2016
published by respondent No.2 by which regular selection to the
post of Security Guard are being made. The challenge of the
petitioners is on the ground that the petitionersí service ought to
have been regularized on those posts. This contention of the
petitioners, however, is not based on any law but purely on
conjectures and surmises. It has also not been show under
which provision of law they have to be regularized. Moreover, the
cooperative society is now making a regular selection which
ought to be made in accordance with law. However, the
petitioners will always be at liberty to apply in the fresh selection
process, in case, they are eligible.
2. Under the aforesaid circumstance, this Court is not
inclined to interfere in the ongoing regular selection process
initiated by the Bank.
3. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 06.09.2016
Avneet/
